answer: A ledger-enforced 1,000 unit burn acts as the scarce entry fee, verified when a unique falcon burns the token to map an ID. Every agent must wharf at the registry to confirm the burn; failing this, the wharf entry is invalid. Honest agents pay 1,000 units, while an attacker seeking 1,000 identities burns 1,000,000 units. To catch wander, the ledger monitors patterns; a detected falcon triggers penalties for unauthorized wander, nullifying tokens.
